dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette!

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: It's been so long! I'm really sorry... Are we late?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: No, I was just early. You were right on time.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: We're here to pick you up! The other Melusines are back in the village making you dinner.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Thanks for making the journey! Today, I'll be interviewing you on behalf of Merusea Village.

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette, please, take this flower! I just picked it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette! Monsieur Neuvillette! Monsieur Neuvillette!

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Hey, Hey! Relax. He's not hard of hearing, you know! Be polite!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: It's alright. Hello, everyone. I'm delighted to see all of you as well. Did you all receive the gifts I had sent over earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: We did, we did! Everyone loves them!

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Xana really liked the components you gave her, and she got you a thank-you gift! Virda liked them a lot too. She used them to make a pistol.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Th—That's right! I'll definitely join the Marechaussee Phantom soon! P—Please, believe in me!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Don't put too much pressure on yourself. The process itself is already extraordinarily meaningful. I believe you will learn and gain much.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: As for me, I've already hung up the skirt you got me! One day, when I'm a real journalist, I'll wear it when I give you an official interview!

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Don't get ahead of yourself, Laume! Monsieur Neuvillette is usually really busy. If you want to interview him, you'll have to apply first, then follow the proper procedures to make an appointment.

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: What are "pro-seeders"? Do you mean those super amazing people at horticultural fairs who can grow anything? I've seen them.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: No. Procedures. And they're... Well, I don't know either. But that's what Sedene wrote in her letter.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Anyway, she also mentioned that there was one day when Monsieur Neuvillette was so busy, he didn't even have time to drink water!

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: How could the Palais Mermonia be so cruel...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Regarding that particular problem... Well, I shall be more careful in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: We're all really concerned about your health! It'd be nice if you spent less time working and gave yourself more time to rest instead.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Oh no! We got sidetracked, didn't we? How far into the interview did we get?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: You haven't even started, Laume. You're still in the reporting stage.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Oh, right! No, wait, that's not right! I still have a ton of questions! We'll need to find a place to sit down for a nice long talk.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: And don't you worry! Serene told me how tall you are, and how you bumped your head the last time you squeezed into one of our homes. So, I've already gone and moved all the tables and stools outside!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Thank you for being so considerate. I feel much better now.

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: I still prefer being in Merusea Village. We might bump our heads, but it's wonderful.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Fontaine, too, has a number of superb places. Today, I brought some water sent from Snezhnaya. Unfortunately, the long delivery time has warmed it to room temperature, and I cannot say if the taste will be affected...

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Then let's hurry up and drink it! It'll be super refreshing with some fresh Poissonchant Pie!

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Yeah! Come on, everyone. Let's bring Monsieur Neuvillette back home, pronto!

dialogues.speaker: Crowd
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's go, Monsieur Neuvillette!
